item.title: Version 1.16.0 released
item.description: Notes: Write full-page notes, formatted with Markdown, with links you can follow to your tasks, lists, outcomes, and other notes.
item.dc:creator: Jeff

item.title: Version 1.13.0 released
item.description: Native iPad app: Planning is easier on a bigger screen. Use Outcomes on your iPad and Apple Silicon Mac, with iCloud sync keeping all of your devices up-to-date, securely.
item.dc:creator: Jeff

item.title: Version 1.12.0 released
item.description: iCloud sync: Your tasks, outcomes, lists, ideas, and Inbox now sync across your devices through iCloud. Titles and notes are encrypted on your device before syncing.
item.dc:creator: Jeff

item.title: Version 1.11.0 released
item.description: Outcomes is now free. Many thanks for everyone’s feedback to date. Please keep it coming!
item.dc:creator: Jeff

item.title: Version 1.9.0 released
item.description: Compact task editor: Faster task entry throughout the app.
item.dc:creator: Jeff

item.title: Version 1.8.0 released
item.description: Enhancements to the Coming Up view, including the ability to hide routines, and controlling display density.
item.dc:creator: Jeff

item.title: Feature: Add link to list
item.description: Adding deep links to lists can be done right from the task, outcome, list, or area to be added. In the item’s menu, tap Link → Add to List and select the list to add the link to.
item.dc:creator: Jeff

item.title: Version 1.7.0 released
item.description: Rewrote onboarding so that the user can enter their own information and/or add the sample data.
item.dc:creator: Jeff

item.title: Feature: Links
item.description: Links are supported in Notes fields and list items. When links exist in a Notes field, tappable versions are shown below the notes. When a list item’s Notes field is a URL, the text is clickable. Choosing Paste link from the list item’s menu grab’s the destination’s title and uses it for the list item in addition to pasting the link in the Notes.
item.dc:creator: Jeff

item.title: Feature: Deep links
item.description: All tasks, outcomes, lists, and areas are deep link-able. Tapping Link → Copy from their respective menus copies a link to that item, e.g., outcomes://list/2DDE193F-D56A-4BC5-8693-03A5EE3A2747.
item.dc:creator: Jeff
